hook: Your phone makes a spinning fan look bent.
title: Your Phone Bends Spinning Fan Blades
description:
Film a ceiling fan with any phone and the blades look bent. The camera reads the picture line by line, called rolling shutter, so the fan moves between lines. The real blades are straight.

#Shorts #phonetricks #tech
comment_prompt: Did your fan look bent? Yes or no
